name: Invisible enemies kit
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 17
Price 900 gp; Weight 4 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit is designed to help adventurers deal with surprise encounters against magically concealed enemies, and comes in a small, waterproof satchel. The kit contains 2 scrolls of glitterdust, 6 1/2-pound packages of powderUE such as flour, and one packet of dust of appearance.
